purpose: Test unchanged v21 on six different existing groups for category-defining relationships and word-meaning clarity while retaining useful broad titles.

groups.selection_reason: Mixed beverage, food accompaniment, ingredient and refusal contexts; avoid forcing a universal activity.

fragments: wine was available with the lamb
Though wine was available with the lamb I don’t drink……wine

groups.selection_reason: Simple object baseline with a bare word and related tag; avoid unnecessary elaboration.
Figurative mental activity across opposite states; preserve shared scope without imposing one direction.
Social relation: kindness/generosity versus status/poverty across different claims.

fragments: not grant someone more priveleges based on status, or similar, but based on kindness and goodness

groups.selection_reason: Activity with a setting; distinguish music at a place from the place as an entity.
Food-use relation shared by a dessert decoration and a savory recipe; preserve ingredient use without forcing either dish.

fragments: Carrots made with real carrots and coconut butter

sample_limits: Different groups from the first v21 test, but all belong to the already known 61-group set. This is an additional development sample, not a wholly unseen holdout. The garden/allotment group was not selected because its known upstream mask ambiguity is outside this title test.
execution: Exact frozen v21 prompt, original instance/fragment order and duplicate masks. Fresh process/thread/empty workspace per call through unchanged codex_exec.py. No full notes, prior titles, selection reasons, IDs, feedback or examples in model input. Tools/web/rules/skills off. First call alone then up to three concurrent. Both repetitions retained; no best-of selection. Stop new scheduling on failure, no automatic retries.
review: Assess every output against masks. Independent support and clear category meanings; no prescribed canonical title. Broadness, benign alternatives and nondeterminism alone are not failures. Preserve different relationships/senses across mixed groups. Separate upstream limitations from title errors. Surface new failures and genuine uncertainty in the existing review tool with exact masks and separate assistant comments.
comparison: No fresh v20 calls. Saved v20 titles are historical context only, not matched trials or fresh controls.
scope_limits: No prompt edits, model changes, cluster/mask edits, TRUE/subsumption calls, hierarchy work, extra generation stages, API credits or new monetary commitments. Main existing subscription only.
